response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack and systems developer with strong open-source and geospatial (GIS) background via GISCollective, but his recent professional experience is overwhelmingly in TypeScript/Node.js/JavaScript web and product engineering. He has minimal recent C++ experience (last substantial C++ role was in 2014-2015 at National Instruments) and no listed Rust experience, no mention of distributed systems fault-tolerance/consistency work, and no navigation/routing pipeline experience, making him a weak match for this C++/Rust-focused routing tiling role.
strengths: Broad, adaptable engineering background across many languages and domains
Genuine geospatial/GIS project experience (GISCollective, Green Map)
Strong track record of ownership, mentoring, and software craftsmanship practices
concerns: No recent professional C++ or Rust experience (most recent C++ work ~10+ years ago)
No evidence of distributed systems, fault tolerance, or service discovery expertise
No experience with routing/navigation guidance pipelines or real-time traffic data integration
